description: Lossless editing JSON contract for crc3d3.neimp.
title: crc3d3.neimp editing JSON
x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep every value at its original type: integers stay integers, floats keep their single precision, and only members documented by the specific CsvData type should change.

x-meido-format-verification.notes: The CRC3D3 CSV loader, the serialization options it passes, and the shared value-tree codec were reviewed. This profile claims the container and value-tree contract only: the field layout of each CsvData type is not published as a schema, so the value tree is edited as data rather than through named members.

x-meido-game-usage: CsvManager supplies the deserialized object graph to the CsvData type that requested the file; the container and the value tree carry no field names of their own.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: CsvManager loads .neimp resources as TextAsset bytes and hands them to MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize with CsvInstances.DefaultOptions, while .nei remains the legacy csvLegacyExtensio path parsed as a CSV table.
The CSV tables use DynamicEnumAsStringResolver plus StandardResolverAllowPrivate plus MessagePackCompression.Lz4BlockArray, so enums travel as strings and payloads may be Lz4BlockArray framed.

The shared value-tree codec writes the editing JSON as a plain dump of the MessagePack tree with no envelope, restores canonical decimal object keys as integer keys, and keeps float32 values at single precision.
